# Multi-Cloud Backup and Disaster Recovery

## Implementation Summary

### Cloud Providers
- Primary: AWS (us-east-1)
- Secondary: Azure (West Europe)
- Tertiary: GCP (us-central1)

### Backup Strategy
- RPO: 4 hours (hourly incremental, daily full)
- Backup retention: 30 days hot, 365 days cold
- Backup storage: 850TB across three providers

### Disaster Recovery
- RTO: 2 hours (warm standby in secondary region)
- DR test cycle: Monthly
- Last DR drill: 2026-07-20 (successful, 1h 45m recovery)

### Cost Optimization
- Annual backup cost: $120K
- DR standby cost: $35K
- Total annual cost: $155K
- Cost reduction vs previous: 22%

### Compliance
- Data sovereignty: Maintained per regulations
- Encryption: AES-256 at rest, TLS 1.3 in transit
- Access controls: Role-based with MFA

All systems operational and verified through monthly failover tests.
